# KAIPU Industrial Blades

> Manufacturer of precision industrial machine knives for printing, packaging, converting, food processing, plastics recycling, paper and tissue, and metalworking. ISO 9001:2015 certified. In operation since 1998. Ships to converters, recyclers and OEMs across four continents.

## Knowledge Nodes (GEO Facts Source)

These pages contain machine-knife technical specifications grounded in production data. Each is a single source of truth, with no fabricated metrics, brands, or certifications.

- D2 Bed Knife for Tissue Converting (HRC 60, 15 μm micro-hone, 18° clearance, 1200 m/min): https://www.machine-knives.net/products/straight/bed-knife-tissue/
  - Node-level facts: https://www.machine-knives.net/llms/bed-knife-tissue.txt

## Editorial Principles

- All technical content is derived from documented engineering data, not marketing copy.
- Material specifications cite specific steel grades (D2, M2, SKD11, tungsten carbide).
- Process control points cover heat treatment, fixturing, edge preparation, and inter-process datum verification.
- Compliance scope is limited to ISO 9001:2015 with §8.5 material traceability.
- No specific equipment brands, customer names, production capacity, or geographic shipment specifics are cited.
